snippet_primary: "That said, Gumroad reserves the right to issue refunds within 90 days of purchase, at its discretion, to prevent chargebacks. So, if you want to have a 'No refunds' policy, that's fine - but be aware that customers can issue chargebacks anytime against their purchases through their credit card"
subject_exact: Gumroad override of seller no-refund policy via discretionary refund right within 90 days to prevent chargebacks
parser_notes: Gumroad can override seller's stated no-refund policy. Separately, buyers can initiate chargebacks via credit card at any time regardless of seller policy. 'Anytime' qualifier for chargebacks noted — no time limit stated for chargebacks in snippet.
